summary: Repo already has this exact item with proof and verification (BRAINSTORM/z52b_fingerprint.md items 188/229/266: isosceles law, D=U at p≡1(4), U−D=2 at p≡3(4)); not promoted to DISCOVERIES. Re-proved: 4/n=2/x+1/z ⟺ (4x−2n)(4z−n)=2n², A=2d, B=n²/d (d | n²), integrality forces only B≡−n (mod 4); for odd n this holds iff n has a prime factor ≡3 (mod 4) (n≡3: take B=1), even n always — so failure ⟺ all prime factors ≡1 (mod 4) (PROVED). CERTIFIED for 2≤n≤3000 by the divisor test (344 failures = A004613 minus 1) and an independent brute force for n≤400, 0 mismatches. One level beyond: it is a fixed-modulus (mod 4) genus obstruction on a rational curve of the surface — an exact B1/T1-type toy (all divisors of n² ≡1 mod 4), and the same failure set as the two-term problem 4/n=1/a+1/b; it says nothing about the growing-modulus certificate lines.

summary: Recomputed the word sieve (scripts/z52b_fingerprint_words.c, n≤3·10⁶, 11 s; ESC(5)=6 reproduced) and U(p) from data/z52b/raw (p≤2·10⁵); dyadic windows of primes p≡1 (4). ESC/log²p: mean drifts slowly down 0.668→0.607 (10³→3·10⁶), window minimum stabilises at 0.096–0.13 from 6·10⁴ on (min/mean 0.15–0.21), sd(log ESC) falls 0.41→0.26; the global minima are the known hard primes (2521: 0.065; 9601, 83449). U/log²p has mean rising 0.81→1.17 (U ≍ log³p, ET), min/mean 0.17–0.31; ESC ≈ 0.57·U on average (corr of logs 0.85), ESC/U ∈ [0.25, 3]. So ESC is the log²-scaled count with a stable floor ≈0.1·log²p in range — a clean calibration constant, but no structure beyond the known hard primes.
next: None needed; if used as a heuristic target, quote min ESC/log²p ≈ 0.10 (p ∈ [6·10⁴, 3·10⁶]).

So F1–F3 are provably all conic-bundle structures (a small completion of GEOMETRY §3.1); ET Type I/II are F1 fibres (fix the denominator), the (★) words are F2 fibres (λ=B/u). Nothing new for ES.
